name: cipher-t1-adfgvx-ts
instr:
Several `Cipher` implementations throw `not implemented`

I’m using `@irfanshadikrishad/cipher` to encrypt messages and recover them with the appropriate key, starting with the classical ciphers advertised in `README.md`.

```ts
import { Cipher } from '@irfanshadikrishad/cipher'
const cipher = new Cipher.Nihilist('MONARCHY', 'EXAMPLE')
const message = 'Meet me at noon.'
const encrypted = cipher.encrypt(message)
const recovered = cipher.decrypt(encrypted)
console.log(recovered)
```

I expect the advertised ciphers to encrypt messages and let the corresponding decrypt operation recover them according to each cipher’s text handling. Follow the existing TypeScript signatures, doc comments, and `FEATURE.md` for the API contract. The cipher guides linked from `README.md` provide algorithm context; their example snippets may use older signatures and are illustrative. Preserve the current signatures when a guide example differs.

Instead, this example throws `Error: not implemented` during construction, before it can encrypt anything. Several other cipher operations still have the same placeholder.

Fill in the remaining stubs, including key generation and public-key import/export operations, in these files under `src/ciphers/`: `ADFGVX.ts`, `Affine.ts`, `Alphabet.ts`, `Autokey.ts`, `Bifid.ts`, `Blowfish.ts`, `ChaCha20.ts`, `DES.ts`, `ECC.ts`, `Nihilist.ts`, `RSA.ts`, `Salsa20.ts`, and `Vigenere.ts`.

The fix must keep the package’s own tests passing and preserve the existing public
